name: tazrim-analysis
description: Turns Israeli household bank and credit-card exports into a monthly cash-flow (תזרים) analysis: parses bank account (עובר ושב) exports (.xlsx/.xls), credit-card monthly statements (פירוט אשראי, .xlsx/.xls), a benefits-club export (.docx) and P2P transfer apps (BIT / PayBox); classifies every transaction; builds a formula-driven Excel workbook with a "לסיווג ידני" sheet for the user's own labels, an interactive dashboard.html and a Hebrew RTL PDF report. Use for "ניתוח תזרים", "ניתוח הוצאות והכנסות", "cash-flow analysis", "Israeli bank exports", "פירוט אשראי", "עובר ושב", "כרטיס אשראי", "BIT", "לסיווג ידני", any number of months, at overview / standard / deep level.
